scripts.typecheck:web: tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM Editor/web/main.ts
scripts.conformance: cargo build -p gx-mock-engine -p gx-mock-editor -p gx-mock-playout && cargo run -p gx-conformance
scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run codegen:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ts && npm run test:rust && npm run conformance
scripts.editor: npm run build:web && tauri dev --config Editor/shell/tauri.conf.json
